name: OpenBSD Sealed Controller Base Adapter
description: Supported adapter mapping for the OpenBSD sealed-brick controller target using only base system interfaces (pf, pfctl, ifconfig, route, rcctl, sysctl, canonical files). No web-admin plane, no LuCI/OpenWrt-style UI replica, smallest practical service surface.

declared_capabilities.name: Bounded read-only v0 posture collection
declared_capabilities.description: Minimized public collection of OpenBSD networking and packet-filter posture booleans and counts. Does not emit IPs, MACs, interface names, routes, rule bodies, resolver values, search domains, or hostnames.
declared_capabilities.evidence_notes: Evidence contract includes mocked-native outputs proving public output does not contain sensitive topology classes, and explicit separate --inspect-private path with LOCAL SENSITIVE OUTPUT warning.

declared_capabilities.name: Offline pf syntax validation rehearsal
declared_capabilities.description: Operator-rehearsed offline pfctl -n syntax validation against candidate pf.conf files. Explicitly local only, no auto-load or mutation from this repo.
declared_capabilities.evidence_notes: Validated through recovery-sequence gates and operator order in the sealed-brick playbook; pending live-hardware confirmation on isolated blueshoes harness.

notes: This adapter is explicitly SUPPORTED for the sealed OpenBSD controller target because it exposes at least one validated capability mapping. Directory name alone is intentionally NOT sufficient for support status.
